cohort: 356 exclusively breastfeeding mothers with infants under 6 months old, attending Bentolhoda Hospital in Bojnoord-Iran, from November 2021 to August 2022.
finding: While the increased chance of infantile colic among infants of mothers who experienced domestic violence was not statistically significant, women in the case group (with colicky infants) had significantly higher scores for 'sexual violence and restraint'.
mod_finding: A significant relationship was found between infantile colic and a history of cesarean section (OR = 1.723, P = 0.044).
